name: Boiled or steamed tube squid
nameVi: Mực ống luộc; mực ống hấp
summary: Mực ống in the Hạ Long seafood meal is boiled or steamed. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, also names a stir-fry with celery, onion, and fresh garlic when the table wants another plate.
origin: Hạ Long. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015. This is the fresh squid, not the squid cake.
howToEat: Boil or steam. The extra plate, if the table is still hungry, is mực ống xào cần tây with onion and fresh garlic.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The ordinary seafood meal. Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020, also lists mực among the live seafood at the market under Núi Bài Thơ.
seoTitle: Muc ong in Ha Long — boiled, steamed, or with celery
seoDescription: Mực ống in Hạ Long is boiled or steamed, or stir-fried with celery, onion, and garlic. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
